C1363.title: bZx Protocol Second Flash Loan Attack
C1363.summary: On February 18, 2020, the DeFi protocol bZx was exploited again in a flash loan attack. The attacker manipulated oracle prices to profit approximately 2,388 ETH, worth around $644,000 at the time. This incident is a classic example of price manipulation via flash loans, causing significant losses to the protocol.
